obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, inverted surfaces, display type on light blocks

snow.$description: Snow — Primary text, high-contrast headings, logo lockup fills

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers, section borders, card outlines, link borders — the only structural separator in the system

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, secondary labels, list items, metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, disabled states, icon strokes, subtle UI annotations

cashsans.$description: All text — Cash App's custom geometric sans. The 400 weight handles body and utility; 500 for sub-labels and nav; 700 reserved for extreme display moments. The type scale is deliberately bimodal: micro (10–16px) for functional UI and monumental (86–122px) for editorial display, with nothing in between.
